description: Automerge every update, majors included, once the required CI checks pass (GitHub native auto-merge). Every version is in MODULE.bazel: the Bazel modules and the build tools' maven.install artifacts (the bazel-module manager), and the app's library versions, the constants maven_kmp.install's coordinates share (a regex manager); renovate-pins.yml then re-pins the lockfiles on the PR's branch (bazel/renovate/repin.sh)

packageRules.description: Kover's 1.0.715 on Maven Central is a 2023 IntelliJ-numbered upload, older than the 0.9.x line, not an upgrade
kotlinx-datetime publishes '-0.6.x-compat' sibling releases; they are not upgrades

Kotlin and what's built for one Kotlin release move together: Kotlin's plugins (the Compose compiler among them), rules_kotlin (it bundles the compiler Bazel runs, which must equal MODULE.bazel's KOTLIN), and the Metro and Mappie compiler plugins. Split groups open PRs that each fail alone

AGP and the lint it runs release together (lint's version is AGP's + 23): @android_tools' AGP, builder and gradle-api (listed only so amend_artifact can break its POM cycle), android_sdk.agp (aapt2) and @android_lint's lint-gradle move as one
@proguard applies the Compose Gradle plugin's default ProGuard rules for the Compose libraries maven_kmp resolves, so the plugin moves with them
Qodana's linter image and the action that runs it release together, one per IDE release (2026.2, 2026.3, …)
The app's library versions are looked up where maven_kmp.install's repositories resolve them: Maven Central or Google's repository (androidx)

zulu-jdk.description: Azul Zulu JDK releases (Linux x64 stands for every platform; repin_jdk.py fails if one lacks the release), as major.minor.patch

customManagers.description: The app's library versions: MODULE.bazel constants maven_kmp.install's artifacts and forces share, each with a `# renovate: <group:artifact>` comment naming the artifact its version is looked up for
The npm packages the browser programs load: MODULE.bazel constants with a `# renovate-npm: <package>` comment
The Go SDK rules_go downloads for the Gazelle extension (MODULE.bazel's go_sdk.download)
The JDK the build runs on and the desktop app bundles (MODULE.bazel's JDK), every Azul Zulu release, LTS or not; repin.sh rewrites its archives, their SHA-256s and .bazelrc's runtime version
The Node.js release the browser tests run on (MODULE.bazel's NODE); repin.sh rewrites its archives' SHA-256s
The pdfium build the PDF parser bundles (MODULE.bazel's PDFIUM, a bblanchon/pdfium-binaries chromium/<build> release); repin.sh rewrites its archives' SHA-256s
The AGP release aapt2 is downloaded from (MODULE.bazel's android_sdk.agp)
The BuildBuddy CLI Build and Test runs its Bazel commands through (build.yml's BB_VERSION); the job checks the download against the release's own SHA-256
